WHY HELPER_MISSING (the stop path): the clone has no stop, abort, halt or emergency command. Cmd_delayed (bin/tecan_funcs.py:57-108) defines only __init__, add_cmd and start; the module's only close() closes the serial port (bin/tecan_funcs.py:201-203). A move already sent cannot be cancelled through this library, and no text of the clone documents an independent hardware e-stop. An R2 driver therefore cannot meet SAFE-045 without inventing a stop command, which the rules exclude. The card's SerialDriver helper cannot express the device either: every frame is STX + rotating sequence letter + unit address + ASCII command + ETX + XOR + newline (bin/tecan_funcs.py:147-164), and the serial bridge's command strings reject control characters and cannot compute the XOR. This package is a direct Driver over the card's class Cmd_delayed with a package native.py transport (DEVIATION FROM THE CARD); it is not a passing package.

WHY PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED (G7): bin/tecan_funcs.py is Python 2 (line 78 is `print self.runningStack`), so the gate's ast.parse cannot read it and G7 reports NATIVE_NOT_FOUND even though the card's class Cmd_delayed exists at line 57. Minimal repro: `python3 -c 'import ast, pathlib; ast.parse(pathlib.Path("labs/tolland/python-tecan-genesis/bin/tecan_funcs.py").read_text())'` raises SyntaxError: Missing parentheses in call to 'print' at line 78. The SDK was not edited.
